items.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 3.14 (compatible with MySQL 8.0.46) is generally available
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 3 (compatible with MySQL 8.0) supports MySQL 8.0.46, which includes community MySQL fixes and Aurora-specific improvements.

items.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 8.4.10 is now generally available
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 8.4 supports MySQL 8.4.10. We recommend upgrading to the newer minor versions to accept fixes for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) in prior versions of MySQL and to benefit…

items.title: Amazon RDS now supports per snapshot billing
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon RDS supports per snapshot billing for Amazon RDS snapshots. Per snapshot billing allows you to get the cost of each individual snapshot.

items.title: Haiku 5.5 now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)
items.blurb: A new Anthropic model is now available in the Kiro IDE and CLI for the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. With Haiku 5.5, all three Claude 5.5 models are now available in Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US).

items.title: AWS Lambda now supports queues for Apache Kafka in self-managed Kafka event sources
items.blurb: AWS Lambda now supports queues for Apache Kafka in self-managed Kafka event source mappings (ESM), for Kafka clusters that customers run themselves and for managed offerings such as Confluent Cloud.

items.title: Amazon Quick on desktop now uses your organization's existing Amazon Quick sign-in
items.blurb: For organizations that use Amazon Quick, the desktop application now signs users in with the same sign-in method the organization already uses for Quick on the web.
